title: Expedition 33 Best Weapons - All Characters Guide
description: Best weapons for all characters in Expedition 33 with locations. Covers Gustave, Lune, Maelle, Sciel, Verso, and Monoco weapon choices and upgrades.

sections.title: Weapon System Overview
sections.content:
Every character in Expedition 33 uses a unique weapon type with distinct scaling, elements, and passive abilities. Understanding the weapon system is crucial for optimizing your builds.

Key Mechanics

  • Weapon Scaling: Stat scaling ranges from D (weakest) to S (strongest) for each attribute (Might, Agility, etc.).
  • Weapon Levels: Upgrade using Chroma Catalysts at the Curator's camp station. Weapons level from 1 to 33.
  • Passive Milestones: At specific upgrade levels (typically 4, 10, 20, 30), weapons unlock passive abilities that can transform a character's playstyle.
  • Elements: Weapons deal specific elemental damage. Use weapons that exploit enemy weaknesses.
  • Free Aim Integration: Weapon element affects gun shots during Free Aim mode, letting you apply elemental effects through basic shooting.

General Weapon Strategy

The "best" weapon often depends on the fight. For general exploration, use your highest-level weapon. For specific bosses, swap to a weapon with the element they're weak to. Endgame builds should focus on weapons whose passive milestones synergize with your skill and Pictos loadout.

sections.title: Gustave Best Weapons
sections.content:
Lanceram — Best All-Rounder

Arguably Gustave's best weapon overall. It offers solid power from early game through endgame and becomes available very early, giving you maximum time to level it up.

  • Location 1: Defeat a Lancelier in Spring Meadows (early Act 1)
  • Location 2: Purchase at higher level from the Cruler in Coastal Cave (21,275 Chroma)

Why it's great: High base power, good scaling, and early availability means you can invest Chroma Catalysts into it from the start. The elemental type provides solid coverage for most encounters.

General Gustave Weapon Strategy

Gustave benefits most from high-power weapons that complement his Overcharge mechanic. Since his Overcharge damage scales with weapon power, keeping his weapon upgraded is more important than for other characters. Swap elements to exploit boss weaknesses — Gustave is often your most flexible party member element-wise.

Key Passive to Look For

Weapons that enhance Mark application or Overcharge generation make Gustave's burst turns more devastating. Pair with Marking Shot skill for consistent setup.

sections.title: Lune Best Weapons
sections.content:
Trebuchim — Best Early Game

Generates a random Stain on Free Aim shots, giving Lune faster access to Stain-dependent abilities like Elemental Genesis. Extremely efficient for building elemental combos.

  • Location 1: Defeat Catapult Sakapatate in Ancient Sanctuary (near Sanctuary Maze rest point)
  • Location 2: Win Gestral Arena's final fight as Lune (but using Maelle here is recommended for Medalum)

Snowim — Best Mid-to-Late Game Sustain

Life-saving sustain weapon that guarantees Lune stays alive. Very high Power stat when fully leveled, plus passive healing, Stain generation, and AP restoration at milestone levels.

  • Location 1: Defeat Gargant in Frozen Hearts
  • Location 2: Defeat Gargant in Flying Manor

Best for: Healer Lune builds. The sustain passives let Lune keep the party alive while also generating resources for offensive spells.

Esquim — Best Endgame DPS

Requires setup but delivers extraordinary damage. Convert Stains to Dark with base attacks, then use skills like Lightning Dance for 300% bonus damage. Works brilliantly with Elemental Trick (creates 4 Stains cheaply).

  • Location: Paint Cage on the main slope at Verso's Drafts entrance. Destroy three nearby red balloons to break the cage.

Cleim — Ultimate Endgame

Reduces damage limitation capabilities but creates an ethereal sword dealing additional damage per skill used. Stacking different Stains via Elemental Trick doubles damage on subsequent turns.

  • Location: Defeat Clea Unleashed in the Endless Tower (extremely difficult endgame fight)

Progression Path

Trebuchim (Ancient Sanctuary) → Snowim (Frozen Hearts/Flying Manor) → Esquim (Verso's Drafts) → Cleim (Endless Tower)

sections.title: Maelle Best Weapons
sections.content:
Medalum — Essential Early Game

Automatically starts Maelle in Virtuose Stance every fight. Also boosts Burn damage, synergizing with Rain of Fire, Pyrolyse, and Burning Canvas. This is Maelle's most important early weapon.

  • Location: Beat the Gestral Arena's final fight as Maelle. This is the ONLY way to get Medalum before postgame! Do not use another character here.

Jarum — Best Mid-Late Game (Burn Focus)

Continues the Burn stacking strategy. Critical passive: switches to Virtuose Stance on Counterattack (Level 4). With consistent Parrying, you stay in Virtuose permanently without using stance-switching skills.

  • Location: Defeat Chromatic Jar boss on the island west of Gestral Village on the world map.

Lithum — Best Late Game (Mark Focus)

Capitalizes on Marked enemies for amplified damage. Grants Virtuose Stance on Counterattack at Level 10. Best paired with Mark-applying teammates (Gustave, Verso).

  • Location: Defeat Alicia in The Reacher (accessible at Maelle relationship level 5).

Which to Choose?

WeaponBest WhenPlaystyle
MedalumAlways available earlyGuaranteed Virtuose + Burn synergy
JarumParty uses Burn (Lune Immolation)Parry-focused, self-sustaining Virtuose
LithumParty applies Marks (Gustave/Verso)Parry-focused, team-synergy damage

sections.title: Sciel Best Weapons
sections.content:
Charnon — Best Overall

Provides 100% Critical Chance during Twilight, which synergizes perfectly with Sealed Fate (Critical Hits don't remove Foretell). At higher levels, also applies Foretell on Critical Hits and grants a stacking 20% damage boost per turn without taking damage (up to 5 stacks).

  • Location: Purchase from Grour the Gestral Merchant in Renoir's Drafts (must defeat him first).

Why it's best: The 100% Crit in Twilight + Sealed Fate combo means Foretell stacks never decay during your damage window. Combined with the stacking damage passive, Sciel's damage grows exponentially each turn she avoids hits.

Tisseron — Best for Twilight Uptime

Increases Twilight damage when using Sun Skills. The game-changing passive: grants an extra turn when entering Twilight. This means your transition turn isn't wasted — you enter Twilight AND immediately get to attack.

  • Location: Earned after defeating Sirene during the main story (Act 2).

Best for: Players who want maximum Twilight uptime. The bonus turn on Twilight entry is incredibly strong for longer fights where you cycle in and out of Twilight multiple times.

Which to Choose?

  • Charnon for maximum damage per Twilight window (guaranteed crits, stacking damage)
  • Tisseron for more total Twilight turns and smoother rotation

sections.title: Verso Best Weapons
sections.content:
Gaulteram — Standard DPS

Provides an elemental type different from Verso's natural Physical/Light skills. Simple but effective — pure damage increase with elemental coverage for weakness exploitation.

Best for: Players who want Verso as a straightforward, self-sufficient damage dealer. Build to S-Rank and attack.

Dualiso — Double Turn Build

Low base damage coefficient but effectively grants two turns per cycle. The first action builds Rank; the second unleashes high-damage finishers.

  • Location: Defeat Dualliste in Forgotten Battlefield (Level 23 Required boss)

Best for: Aggressive players who can protect Verso's Rank. The double action lets him reach S-Rank faster and deal more total damage per cycle. Pair with Enfeebling Attack, Combo Attack I, and Greater Defenceless Luminas.

Sireso — Support/Amplifier Build

Fundamentally changes Verso's role. He no longer gains personal damage from Rank — instead his Rank provides a damage bonus to all allies. Build to S-Rank, then support with Powerful and Marking Shot.

  • Location: Obtained from Axon Sirene

Best for: Teams with a dedicated DPS (Maelle Sword Ballet, Sciel Twilight). Verso becomes the ultimate force multiplier — his S-Rank buffs make your actual damage dealer hit astronomically hard.

Comparison

WeaponRoleDamage Source

DualisoBurst DPS (double turns)Personal attacks + extra actions
SiresoTeam AmplifierAlly damage through Rank bonus

sections.title: Monoco Best Weapons
sections.content:
Ballaro — Best Support

The standout choice for support Monoco builds. Level 10 and Level 20 passive milestones provide additional AP to all other party members when Monoco uses Upgraded Skills. This turns Monoco into a party-wide AP battery.

Why it's incredible: AP is the most valuable resource in combat. Monoco generating AP for your entire party means your DPS characters can use expensive skills every single turn. Pair with Potier Energy skill for even more party AP generation.

DPS Weapon Strategy

For DPS Monoco builds focused on Bestial Wheel transformations, the best weapon depends on which enemy forms you've unlocked. Later transformations are inherently stronger, so focus on defeating optional bosses to expand Monoco's form library.

Monoco's Role

Unlike other characters with clear "best" weapons, Monoco's optimal choice depends entirely on his role:

  • Support role: Ballaro (AP generation for allies) is clearly superior
  • DPS role: Prioritize weapons that enhance his strongest available transformations
  • Flex role: Ballaro still works — the AP generation benefits everyone regardless of what Monoco does on his own turn

Recommendation: Default to Ballaro unless you have a specific DPS build in mind. The party-wide AP generation is too valuable to pass up in most team compositions.
